meta.title: Competitor AI knowledge graph
meta.notes: Products carry `by` (owning institution), `uses` (partners/technology) and `caps` (capabilities); build.py expands these into edges. `conf`: verified = primary or multiple sources; secondary = single secondary source; unverified = flagged in the research notes. `ai`: agentic | genai | ml | rules | none.
